description: Defines classes and interfaces for cryptographic proof verification in QUIC protocol, including ProofVerifyDetails, ProofVerifyContext, ProofVerifierCallback, and ProofVerifier.

classes.name: ProofVerifyDetails
classes.description: Abstract class for storing implementation-specific proof verification details.

classes.name: ProofVerifyContext
classes.description: Abstract class for storing implementation-specific context for proof verification.

classes.name: ProofVerifierCallback
classes.description: Interface for callback mechanism after asynchronous proof verification.

classes.name: ProofVerifier
classes.description: Interface for verifying proofs and certificate chains in QUIC.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Returns a copy of ProofVerifyDetails with the same contents.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Callback invoked upon completion of asynchronous verification.

methods.name: VerifyProof
methods.description: Verifies server proof, signature, and certificate chain asynchronously.

methods.name: VerifyCertChain
methods.description: Verifies that a certificate chain is valid for a hostname asynchronously.

methods.name: CreateDefaultContext
methods.description: Creates a default proof verification context.
